help: the standing forge report, the acts, the checkout's own state: refuse-class drift refuses before anything irreversible, the squash lands pinned to the inspected head, this checkout converges on the PR's base, what the merge just orphaned is swept by prune --apply, the merge commit is read back, and the last word is the checkout's own state (git status --short --branch); the forge's roster stays one command away — no message flags, so the body is assembled from the branch's commits and keeps their signatures

args.name: pr
args.help: the PR to merge: a number, a URL, or a branch

sends: gh pr view — reads the PR's head, base, and head branch name before the irreversible step, and reads the merge commit back after it
git fetch origin <base> <head> — reads both refs before the irreversible step, so a branch behind its base stops the chain on git's own exit before anything irreversible
gh pr merge --squash — WRITES the merge (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
git push origin --delete — prune --apply, sweeping the server branches this merge and its siblings left (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
git fetch origin — reads the squash back so the base can fast-forward
